name: 14624 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14624 (Rochester) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14624 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
